REC50-R03: a Kosovo Police spokesman, quoted by Lajmi.net and republished by Periskopi, reported all-vehicle entry into Albania resumed at about 15:00 on 31 March 2018. KOHA/KTV also reported a stage limited to Albanian-plated vehicles, but its displayed 16:01 article time is later than Periskopi’s 15:43 item. Article timestamps do not settle the actual intermediate sequence. Retain the existing same-day phase as police-attributed reopening evidence and preserve uncertainty about category-specific sequencing and exact minutes.
